title: Special Edition: The Shield Hero’s Valentine’s Day Part 16
text: I’m at home working on the planning and prototyping products in preparation for the next event.
“Master—”
For some reason, Filo has come home.
“Weren’t you supposed to be staying at Zeltoble with Melty tonight?”
“Well, you see… Mel-chan said this was a present for you, Master,”

Filo said, handing me a box filled with chocolates. Come to think of it… I haven’t actually received anything from Melty yet. I wish that prickly girl would just make up her mind—does she like me or not? Just like the female knight, I want her to be clear about it. How lazy is it to just have Filo deliver it for her?
“So, this is Filo’s—”
Filo handed me some genuine, homemade chocolates—the kind fans drool over. But…
“Filo.”
“What?”
I took a familiar-looking object from Filo. It was about the size of a fist… round and bumpy. It had a… faint, strange smell.
“Did you really make this yourself?”
“Yeah. When I showed Mel-chan what I made, she told me to use something someone else made instead, but I know homemade is best, so I made this in secret.”
“Oh, I see…”
Yeah, it just happened to turn out with a similar shape by chance. It looks just like that thing my jerk of a dad made.
“Filo, have you tasted it yet?”
“Nnnn. Not yet.”
“All right, all right, Filo. If you want to give it to someone else to eat, you have to try it first.”
“If I eat it, will you eat some too, Master?”
“If you finish it all, sure.”
“Yay!”
Filo took the chocolate she’d made from me and took a bite.
“Yaaaaaah! Pfft! It’s bitter—it tastes awful!”
“I see, I see. That’s good then.”
If she’d eaten it like it was delicious, I was about to kick her out. With tears in her eyes, Filo stares sadly at her chocolate and throws it away.
“Here, eat this to cleanse your palate.”
Since I had no choice, I gave Filo a slice of chocolate cake I’d made ahead of time in the kitchen.
“Yay! This is delicious!”
“If you want me to eat your chocolate, listen carefully to what Melty has to say and keep practicing until she says it’s okay.”
“Okay! Filo will do my best!”
Seriously… Filo, don’t go doing things you don’t need to. Filo munches away on the chocolate cake at home. Just then, a knock-knock sound came from the front door.
Who could it be…? Did they come to give me chocolate too, just like Filo, a little late to the party? When I opened the door, there stood Fohl, Atla, and Gaelion.
“What’s up? You already got chocolate from Atla, didn’t you?”
“That’s true, but my big brother…”
Atla looked troubled and seemed to be held back by Fohl.
“Cure!”
Gaelion, too, had a box strapped to his back—I wondered what he was up to. Was it a delivery or something? Anyway, I invited them inside.
“What’s going on?”
Filo, still stuffing her face with chocolate cake, watched us with a puzzled look.
“I don’t know.”
Once inside, Fohl’s eyes were filled with determination. What was this? Did he have a proposal or something?
“Hmm!”
Roughly, Fohl let go of Atla’s hand—which he’d been holding—and reached into the bag slung around his waist, then held out the contents to me with both hands.
“T-this!”
Speaking in a stammering, almost inarticulate way, Fohl bowed his head and thrust the wrapped box toward me with such force it almost felt like he was shoving it at me.
“What is it? Did someone from the village tell you to deliver some chocolate on their behalf?”
Huh?　Gaelion, as if feeling threatened by Fohl’s attitude, bared his teeth and let out a menacing “Cyaaaaaa!”
“No!”
“Then what is it?”
“I-it’s Valentine’s Day chocolate from me!”
“Huh?”

Why do I have to accept a chocolate gift from a guy like Fohl? Oh… is this “friend chocolate”? I’d been vague about it, but did he hear from the other heroes that there are gifts exchanged between men? Or maybe among the Hakuko race, there’s a tradition where men give chocolate to other men.
“It’s that ‘token of appreciation’ thing, I guess.”
Since ‘friend chocolate’ also implies something like ‘let’s stay friends,’ I’ll take it as Fohl’s way of showing his sincerity. Atla, now free, is clinging to my elbow or so, but…
“That’s not it!”
“Huh?”
Fohl clenches his fist tightly as he answers, looking at me, who just received the chocolate.
“This is my… heartfelt gift!”
“…What do you mean by that?”
I ask, feeling a very bad premonition. What is this? I feel like a chill is running down my spine. Filo also noticed something was off and hurried over.
“I’m showing my love for you, big bro! That’s right! Big bro, I like you!”
…I can really feel my expression stiffening. I think I must have scowled as hard as I could.

Still, Fohl’s feelings have taken a weird turn. I thought he was just an extreme siscon, but does he actually have a thing for men too? Of course, I don’t have any interest in that sort of thing. Naturally, I’m going to reject this outright without discussion.
However, Fohl has been devoted to me in his own way. I can’t just brush him off, so I guess I’ll at least hear him out.
“What on earth makes you say you like me? Tell me the whole story.”
Well… there must be some reason for this. Otherwise, he wouldn’t say something like that. Even Fohl would be able to tell just by watching me that I’m normal.
“A lot has happened since we first met. You’ve been good to both me and Atla, and if Big Bro hadn’t taken me in, I would’ve lost everything.”
“Well… I guess so. But what does that have to do with love?”
“I love my big bro, but I also love Atla very much. However, Atla might not feel the same way about me as I do.”

So you finally get it. To be honest, Atla’s kind of cold-hearted—she only ever sees her brother as a brother. She acts like a little sister who’s fed up with her big brother being way too clingy. As someone raised on subculture, I find it a bit awkward, but by society’s standards, that’s actually the healthier and more normal way to be.
“But she cares deeply about my brother, and I care about him just as much as Atla does.”
“Uh-huh… So?”
“That’s when she said to me… ‘Are you really sure those feelings of yours are right?’”
“Huh?”
“Then she continued, ‘Once Atla becomes a spirit, she’ll only be able to think of you as just an ordinary older brother from now on. Can you really live with that?’”
Who the hell is that?! What kind of idiot would spout nonsense like that to Fohl?!

“‘Face your own heart,’ they said. ‘You want Atla to remember you for the rest of her life, don’t you? Then, face the feelings deep within your heart. The best thing to do is to pour out the full extent of your feelings to the one Atla loves—the Shield Hero.’ Hearing that, it was like a wake-up call.”
…… Um, I kind of get what he’s saying, but I’m not quite catching the main point.
“I… want Atla to come at me harder. I want her to think about me. That’s one answer, and I’ve decided to be honest with myself!”

Oh no… there’s something off about Fohl’s eyes. It’s not like the Curse Series or anything, but his behavior is getting weird because of someone’s whispers. Come to think of it, he’s been acting a little strange lately. It was like he was troubled by something, or just spacing out—something like that.

“That’s it! If the big brother I love becomes mine, then Atla will feel hatred toward me… she’ll hate me for the rest of her life! I thought it was a brilliant plan—killing two birds with one stone—so I came here to confess!”

Are you an idiot? What’s so ‘killing two birds with one stone’ about that? If anything, your actions are heading straight toward losing everything. He’s completely lost it. Confessing to the guy his little sister likes just because he loves her so much—that’s not something a sane person would do. Who is this? What kind of idiot has driven Fohl to this point?
“…I see, Big Brother… So it’s safe to assume you’ve come here with the serious intention of winning Naofumi over?”
Atla swayed slightly, radiating a murderous aura as she turned to face Fohl.
“That’s right. I’ve slept with Big Brother—by mutual consent. Atla, I’m a step—or two—ahead of you!”
“Hahahahaha… Big Brother, so you’re joining the race as a romantic Rival? Very well.”

What the hell is Atla getting so caught up in this atmosphere for?! And Filo, stop tilting your head like that! As for Gaelion… he’s been growling menacingly this whole time. Go ahead, let Fohl attack you!
“I thought I’d just tuck you away in a corner of my memory after Big Brother passed away, but no matter how many centuries pass, I’ll remember you.”
“Heh heh heh heh heh, I won’t lose to you, Atla! I’m going to steal Big Brother right from under your nose!”
“Did you really think I’d just nod along to that, you idiots?!”

Seriously, who was that?! Who pushed Fohl’s back in that weird way and made him fall?! Nine times out of ten, it’s the Tailor. She’s a total yaoi fan, after all. I saw her talking about it the other day—so this is what she was talking about? Whispering stuff like this, hoping for a BL story between me and Fohl… I really need to start thinking about banishing her for good!

Motoyasu is in danger too. For the same reason, he’ll probably become a target of Filo’s hatred, so he might start saying he’s going to seduce me. But for now, I’ve got to deal with these idiots first.
“Get out! Get out!”
I grab Fohl by the scruff of his neck and kick him out of the house. Atla comes with him, of course.
“Go take a dip in the water and cool off!”
I throw a box of chocolates at him while I’m at it.
“Ah, Big Bro! I’m not giving up!”
“What do you mean, ‘not giving up’? Go try again later! You idiot!”
Fohl keeps pounding on the front door. He knows I’ll get even angrier if he breaks it, so he’s just sticking to banging on it.
“Naofumi-sama—”
“I won’t let you!”
“Nwaa! Big Brother, please let me go—a wall like this is practically nothing to me!”
“That’s exactly why I won’t let you! I’m going to stay with Big Brother until the end!”
From there, I started hearing the sounds of a chaotic struggle. Most likely, she’s locked in a battle with Atla. Seriously… what a pair of idiots. Don’t go getting brainwashed or anything!
“Filo’s so surprised!”
“Yeah, I guess so.”
“Filo wants to sleep with Master, too.”
“You’ve got Melty, don’t you? Just deal with it.”
“Ehh…”
I can’t sleep with the world’s top idol… plus, there’s that thing during her heat cycle.
With that in mind, I headed back to my room, where Gaelion was waiting for me with sparkling eyes.
